svg.title: SAGE registry, routing, execution, and lifecycle architecture
svg.desc: A component architecture showing persistent routing inputs, the four-stage runtime router, bounded generated-tool bundle, compilation and injection, natural actor use, execution telemetry, side-effect auditing, reflection, lifecycle decisions, and checkpoint reuse.

text.tspan: Scenario identifiers and historical contribution evidence
Immediate incident rules plus periodic reflection
Pulse every four tasks after the first eight
Code repair occurs before admission; runtime changes future
